items.title: Introducing Adaptive Intelligence: Undermining the economics of every bot attack

Cloudflare's new Adaptive Intelligence engine flips this dynamic by autonomously learning from the meta-signals of live traffic and deploying disposable rules, making automated attacks too expensive to sustain.
